reason: Classified as a notifications-focused DSH plugin: its primary user-facing function is alerting users about relevant background session completion events and surfacing a pending-notification count in UI badges, which maps directly to notifications/monitoring rather than coding, research, or file/terminal automation.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web UI 插件，用于在后台会话需要关注时弹出系统通知或发出提示音，并同步在应用图标/标题中显示待处理提醒数量。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web UI plugin that alerts users when background sessions need attention with notifications or chime sound, and shows a pending reminder count as an app badge on icon/title with fallbacks.

capabilities: Displays user-facing alerts when non-active DSH sessions finish turns requiring attention.
Provides system notifications with an audio chime fallback when notification APIs are unavailable.
Shows a pending reminder count as an app/taskbar/tab/fav icon badge.
Supports clicking a notification to return focus to the related conversation.

reasons.code: README states it is a DSH Web UI plugin for notifying when background sessions complete (question asked, plan finished, turn/session completed, or error).
README explains alerts are emitted via Web Notifications API with a fallback synthesized Web Audio chime.
README describes badge updates via App Badging API with tab title and favicon fallback, and badge clearing on focus.
Package metadata declares a web plugin bundle for DSH runtime with no external service dependency list beyond client/runtime peer packages.
Repository layout includes DSH plugin files and README indicating prebuilt lib shipped directly, consistent with browser-side behavior.
